name: Gorilla Gold Mines Ltd
summary: Headquartered in Subiaco, Australia, and established in 1970, Gorilla Gold Mines Ltd focuses on the discovery and advancement of mineral resources throughout Australia. The company actively seeks out a variety of valuable deposits, including gold, lithium, rare earth elements, copper, tungsten, and nickel. This entity was previously known as Labyrinth Resources Limited until its rebranding to Gorilla Gold Mines Ltd in February 2025.
